get.summary: Read a bounded window from a saved source
get.description: Reads text already saved in the completed run result. Content is preferred; snippet is used when content is empty. Offsets and lengths count Unicode code points. This endpoint makes no upstream calls. `truncated` reports remaining stored text; `upstream_truncated` reports text omitted before storage and cannot be repaired by paging.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based Unicode code-point offset; an offset equal to total_chars returns an empty terminal window.

parameters.name: max_chars
parameters.description: Maximum Unicode code points returned in this window.

200.description: Bounded saved source text window

401.description: Missing, invalid, or revoked bearer token

404.description: Run is not owned by this principal or source ID is not present

/v1/runs/{id}/sources/{source}.description: Reads text already saved in the completed run result. Content is preferred; snippet is used when content is empty. Offsets and lengths count Unicode code points. This endpoint makes no upstream calls. `truncated` is true when this window is not the entire stored text (including nonzero-offset windows); `upstream_truncated` indicates text already omitted before or during storage, which paging cannot recover.

cookieAdmin.name: soseek_admin_session
cookieAdmin.description: 12-hour HttpOnly SameSite=Strict management session, Secure when HTTPS is used. This cookie is accepted only by /admin/api routes; it does not authenticate /v1 endpoints.

SSEEventData.description: JSON payload for a persisted event. Its fields vary by event name.

providers.description: Optional provider allowlist. Omitted or empty means all configured providers.

configured.description: Whether a usable key exists, independently of disabled.

disabled.description: Disabled references fail closed and do not fall back to the configured source.

overridden.description: Whether a persistent panel override exists; reset restores the configured file/environment source.

token.description: Plaintext caller API token returned only at creation or rotation; store it now because it cannot be retrieved again.

expires_in.description: Fixed 12-hour, non-sliding session lifetime in seconds.

truncated.description: True when this window does not contain the entire stored field, including a later window beginning at a nonzero offset.

upstream_truncated.description: True when the saved source itself was already truncated upstream or at ingestion; paging cannot recover omitted text.
